card.name: The word Enter, split or form prompt
card.fires_on: The word "Enter" in two settings: as the start of a medical term like enterocolitis or Enterococcus, and as a web form prompt such as "Enter your email address".

modes.label: Start of enter- medical terms
modes.description: "Enter" begins a longer gut-related term such as enterocolitis, enteropathy or Enterococcus.

modes.label: Web form prompt
modes.description: "Enter" begins an instruction asking the reader to type an email, city or comment.

card.plain: It fires on the word Enter, whether it starts a gut-related medical term or a website prompt to type something in.
